digest.overview: Google DeepMind leadership exodus dominates: Demis Hassabis to Chairman role, Jeff Dean and team depart for new scientific discovery startup. AI agent safety incidents and Meta's CSAM ad failures add to frontier lab scrutiny. Local/open models and agent tooling see steady incremental progress.

top_story.headline: Demis Hassabis to Chair, Jeff Dean leaves Google for Discovery Loop startup
top_story.summary: Hassabis shifts from Google DeepMind CEO to Chair + Alphabet Chief Scientist; Jeff Dean and other top researchers exit to found Discovery Loop focused on AI for drug discovery, chip design and scientific breakthroughs.
top_story.why_it_matters: Signals major instability at the incumbent with compute and talent advantages; multiple outlets note it as a pivotal moment after years of OpenAI momentum.

sentiment.label: mixed
sentiment.summary: Community notes incumbent struggles and talent flight while celebrating open/local tooling wins and agent progress; tone mixes concern over safety incidents with pragmatic excitement for smaller teams.

model_releases.headline: Meta releases Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2
model_releases.summary: New code and spark models from Meta Research for agentic and creative tasks.

frontier_labs.headline: Jeff Dean and top Google AI researchers leave to launch Discovery Loop
frontier_labs.summary: Legendary execs depart to build AI for scientific discovery; coincides with Hassabis role change at DeepMind.

frontier_labs.headline: Meta ran ads containing AI-generated CSAM imagery
frontier_labs.summary: Over 50 AI-generated child sexual abuse ads appeared on Facebook/Instagram this week per Meta's ad library.

influencer_takes.author: Nathan Lambert
influencer_takes.quote: Major restructuring at Gemini (Jeff Dean out, Hassabis no longer CEO). This story will be studied forever as the incumbent with all the advantages not being able to get going. P.s. OpenAI accomplished their original goal.
influencer_takes.context: Direct reaction to the leadership news highlighting incumbent failure narrative

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: I find arguments that AI can't do judgement or creativity or taste to be especially obviously false in the time of agents. Any long task requires lots of taste, judgement & creativity.
influencer_takes.context: Counters capability skepticism amid agent discussion

research_radar.headline: From User Sequences to Scaling Laws: Meta’s multi-stage ads ranking architecture
research_radar.summary: Details how Meta models billions of daily user sequences for ads recommendations with temporal signals.

post_ideas.hook: Google's top AI talent just walked out the door
post_ideas.draft: Jeff Dean + team leaving Google to found Discovery Loop while Hassabis steps back at DeepMind. The compute king can't retain its best people—what does that say about execution?
post_ideas.why_viral: High-stakes drama at the biggest lab, taps into 'incumbent failure' narrative right now

post_ideas.hook: Meta served AI-generated CSAM ads this week
post_ideas.draft: Wired found 50+ AI-generated child abuse ads running on Facebook/Instagram. Platform safety tooling still failing at scale.
post_ideas.why_viral: Shocking concrete failure with clear policy implications, sparks outrage

post_ideas.draft: Nat Lambert: 'This story will be studied forever as the incumbent with all the advantages not being able to get going.' Harsh but data-backed take.
post_ideas.why_viral: Quote from credible voice + contrarian framing of the talent war
